About

A place
with a soul

SUNSET ART is a chic spot full of original art and amazing views.

Located on the beachfront of beautiful Chernomorets, SUNSET ART creates the perfect atmosphere to enjoy nature in this amazing destination—so you can disconnect… to reconnect.
